limitations: Two independent new-player simulations using the same single seed and authored construction order, not a population estimate or fastest play.
The chosen order upgrades optional warehouse 4 before home 5; this is not a new house prerequisite.
Automated presence 07–23 each day with immediate decisions; the last started job may continue overnight.
Full daily gifts are projected by real domain calendar and inventory transitions, not HTTP receipt integration.
No player market, barter, achievements, merchant, tap income or admin grants. No purchased production slots.
Construction speedups require a nonzero starting pearlBudget; here zero means gifted pearls are not spent.
Only TypeScript domain commands were simulated; this is not a PostgreSQL, browser or Ktor runtime playthrough.
metadata.catalogRevision: Warehouse 2 and 3 also require no developed house or other buildings.
